master.name: cv_documents
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE cv_documents (
  id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  account_id   TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

  -- Per-account version, starting at 1. The member's timeline of their own CV.
  -- 每人从 1 递增。这就是「不同 CV 时间戳和版本」的版本。
  version      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0),

  filename     TEXT,
  note         TEXT,                    -- member's own label, e.g. "for data roles"

  -- sha256 of the PLAINTEXT. Same content resubmitted = same version returned,
  -- not a new one — a version list full of identical entries answers nothing.
  -- 明文的 sha256。同样的内容再交一次返回原版本，不新开 —— 全是重复的版本列表回答不了任何问题。
  sha256       TEXT NOT NULL,
  size_bytes   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (size_bytes > 0),

  -- AES-256-GCM. iv is per-row random 12 bytes; both base64.
  iv           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(iv) > 0),
  ciphertext   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(ciphertext) > 0),

  -- Consent recorded VERBATIM at upload, same pattern as job_subscriptions:
  -- it names AI review (DeepSeek, servers in China) and the redaction step.
  -- A year later "what exactly did they agree to" must be answerable.
  -- 同意原话逐字存档，和邮件订阅同一个模式 —— 一年后要能回答「他同意的到底是什么」。
  consent_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  consent_at   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (consent_at > 0),

  created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  UNIQUE (account_id, version),
  UNIQUE (account_id, sha256)
)

master.name: cv_reviews
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE cv_reviews (
  id                 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  cv_id              TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cv_documents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  account_id         TEXT NOT NULL,     -- denormalised for the admin list
  model              TEXT NOT NULL,
  rubric_version     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  status             TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('done','failed')),

  -- The verdict is ADMIN-FACING ONLY. Red line 5: nothing AI writes reaches a
  -- member before Gabriel has read it. The member API never selects this column.
  -- 结论只给管理员看。红线 5：AI 写的任何东西，过了 Gabriel 的眼才会到会员那里。
  verdict_json       TEXT CHECK (verdict_json IS NULL OR json_valid(verdict_json)),

  prompt_tokens      INTEGER,
  completion_tokens  INTEGER,
  cache_hit_tokens   INTEGER,           -- prefix-cache hits — the number to watch
  cache_miss_tokens  INTEGER,
  -- Integer micro-CNY. Price-per-1M-tokens in CNY happens to equal µCNY per
  -- token, so cost = Σ tokens × price, all integers, no float drift.
  -- 每百万 token 的人民币价恰好等于每 token 的微元 —— 全整数，无浮点误差。
  cost_ucny          INTEGER,
  latency_ms         INTEGER,
  redactions         INTEGER,           -- how many emails/phones/links were stripped
  error              TEXT,
  created_at         INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0)
)

master.name: digest_run_jobs
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE digest_run_jobs (
  run_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES digest_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  job_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- 邮件里的名次。续页从第 51 名开始，顺序和邮件完全一致 ——
  -- 它是那封信的下半页，不是第二个搜索界面。
  -- The rank inside that email. The continuation starts at #51 in the same
  -- order: it is the second half of that message, not a second search surface.
  rank         INTEGER NOT NULL,
  bucket       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (bucket IN ('local','matched')),
  -- 这张表【只存放不下的那些】。进了信的岗位已经在 job_deliveries 里，
  -- 连同它自己的 click_token —— 再抄一份就是两个都可能变成对方的反例。
  -- Only the roles that did not fit. The ones that did are already in
  -- job_deliveries with their own click_token; a second copy would just be two
  -- records able to contradict each other.
  score        REAL,
  matched      TEXT,          -- 命中的技能，JSON 数组
  -- 续页里的岗位没有 job_deliveries 行（它们没被投递过），所以点击要走自己的
  -- token。刻意【不】给它们写 job_deliveries：那张表的主键 (account_id, job_id)
  -- 意思是「这个岗位对这个人永久去重」，写进去等于让他此后再也收不到这些岗位的邮件。
  -- Remainder roles have no job_deliveries row, so clicks need their own token.
  -- Deliberately NOT writing job_deliveries for them: that table's primary key
  -- means "permanently deduplicated for this person", so writing it here would
  -- guarantee these roles never reach them by email at all.
  click_token  TEXT UNIQUE,
  title_raw    TEXT NOT NULL,
  company      TEXT,
  location_raw TEXT,
  region       TEXT,
  url          TEXT,
  posted_at    INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (run_id, job_id)
)

master.name: digest_runs
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE digest_runs (
  -- 不可猜的 id：它会出现在会员的 URL 里（/my-jobs.html?run=…），
  -- 所以必须是随机的，不能是「账号+日期+档」拼出来的。
  -- Opaque because it appears in a member-visible URL; never derived from
  -- account + day + slot, which anyone could construct for anyone else.
  id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  account_id    TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  day           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (day GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
  slot          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (slot IN ('morning','afternoon')),

  -- 定时的还是手动补发的。分开记是因为【手动发过一次】不能算作
  -- 「定时任务今天跑过了」的证据 —— 那正好会掩盖 cron 已经挂了这件事。
  -- A manual send must never stand as evidence that cron ran; that is precisely
  -- the confusion that would hide a dead scheduler.
  trigger_kind  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trigger_kind IN ('scheduled','manual')),

  -- 四种结局，互不塌陷：
  --   running  开始了还没落定（Worker 中途被回收时会停在这里，这是【诚实】的）
  --   sent     信发出去了
  --   quiet    检查正常完成，当时没有符合条件的新岗位 —— 这【不是】失败
  --   failed   准备或投递失败，我们不知道他收到了什么
  -- Four outcomes that cannot collapse into one another. `running` is what a
  -- killed Worker leaves behind, and leaving it visible is the honest answer.
  outcome       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('running','sent','quiet','failed')),
  failure_stage TEXT,          -- 'prepare' | 'deliver'
  message       TEXT,          -- 失败原因，给人看的一句话

  -- ── 计数是【发信当时的快照】，不是打开页面时重算的 ──────────────────────
  --
  -- 重算会让页面自相矛盾：邮件里写着 50 个，三小时后打开页面池子变了，
  -- 「未包含 7 个」变成「未包含 21 个」，而那 7 个才是他当时真正错过的。
  -- 快照是唯一能让邮件和页面永远说同一句话的做法。
  --
  -- Counts are the send-time snapshot, never recomputed when the page opens.
  -- Recomputing makes the page contradict the email: the message said 50, the
  -- pool moved on, and "7 not included" silently becomes "21" — when 7 is what
  -- they actually missed. The snapshot is the only way the two can keep saying
  -- the same thing.
  --
  -- 全部可空，且【失败时必须是 NULL 而不是 0】。
  -- 0 是一个断言（「一个都没有」），失败时我们没有资格做这个断言。
  -- All nullable, and a FAILURE MUST WRITE NULL, NEVER 0. Zero is a claim that
  -- there were none; after a failure we are not entitled to make that claim.
  cap_per_bucket   INTEGER,
  n_available      INTEGER, n_shown      INTEGER, n_remainder      INTEGER,
  near_available   INTEGER, near_shown   INTEGER, near_remainder   INTEGER,
  else_available   INTEGER, else_shown   INTEGER, else_remainder   INTEGER,
  -- 池子查询有 LIMIT 400。真到顶了就把这件事记下来 ——
  -- 悄悄截断会让 n_available 少报，而少报看起来和「市场安静」一模一样。
  -- The pool query has LIMIT 400. If it ever binds, say so: a silent truncation
  -- understates n_available, and understating looks exactly like a quiet market.
  pool_truncated   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (pool_truncated IN (0,1)),

  started_at    INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (started_at > 0),
  completed_at  INTEGER
)

master.sql:
CREATE TABLE job_daily (
  day            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (day GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
  role_family    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
  seniority      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
  region         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',

  new_count      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- 当天【首次出现】的岗位数
  open_count     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- 当天【在挂】的岗位数
  closed_count   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- 当天【最后一次出现】的岗位数

  -- 薪资分位数。salary_n 是有薪资的样本量 —— 报表里必须一起显示，
  -- 3 个样本算出来的中位数和 300 个的不是一回事。

  salary_p25     INTEGER,
  salary_p50     INTEGER,
  salary_p75     INTEGER,

  computed_at    INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (computed_at > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (day, role_family, seniority, region)
)

master.name: job_subscriptions
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE job_subscriptions (
  account_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES employers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

  -- 两个独立的开关。
  -- portal 默认【开】：在自己的门户里看，不打扰任何人，也不受 UEMA 管。
  -- email  默认【关】：发信是主动打扰，必须由他自己明确打开（opt-in）。
  --   这不只是守法，也是对的做法 —— 默认发信换来的订阅数是虚的。
  email_enabled    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (email_enabled IN (0,1)),
  portal_enabled   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (portal_enabled IN (0,1)),

  -- 筛选偏好。NULL = 全部。存 JSON 数组，例 '["data","backend"]'
  role_families    TEXT CHECK (role_families IS NULL OR json_valid(role_families)),
  regions          TEXT CHECK (regions       IS NULL OR json_valid(regions)),
  seniorities      TEXT CHECK (seniorities   IS NULL OR json_valid(seniorities)),

  -- ── 同意证据（UEMA s 9(3)）──────────────────────────────────────────────
  consent_at       INTEGER,   -- 打开邮件推送的那一刻
  consent_ip_hash  TEXT,      -- 和别处一样只存哈希
  consent_source   TEXT CHECK (consent_source IS NULL OR
                     consent_source IN ('portal_toggle','signup','admin','import')),
  consent_text     TEXT,      -- 他当时屏幕上那句话，逐字。这是唯一能回答
                              -- 「他同意的到底是什么」的东西

  -- ── 退订 ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  -- token 放在邮件链接里，点一下就退，不需要登录也不需要输邮箱。
  -- 让人为了退订先登录，本身就是 UEMA 说的「不合理的困难」。
  unsub_token      TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(unsub_token) >= 20),
  unsubbed_at      INTEGER,   -- 非空 = 已退订。粘性的：再打开需要一次全新的同意
  unsub_source     TEXT,

  created_at       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  updated_at       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at > 0)
, stack TEXT, home_region TEXT, digest_slots TEXT)

master.name: jobs
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE jobs (
  id             TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('seek','indeed','other')),
  external_id    TEXT NOT NULL,              -- 来源站自己的 job id，用来去重
  url            TEXT,

  -- 原始字段：永远保留，归一规则改了可以拿它重跑（坑 1 的后悔药）
  title_raw      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(title_raw) > 0),
  company        TEXT,
  location_raw   TEXT,

  -- 归一字段：入库时算好。全部可空 —— 归一不出来就是不出来，
  -- 宁可留空让它在报表里显示成「未分类」，也不要硬塞进错的桶。
  role_family    TEXT,     -- 'backend' 'frontend' 'fullstack' 'data' 'devops' 'ai' 'qa' 'pm' …
  seniority      TEXT CHECK (seniority IS NULL OR seniority IN ('junior','mid','senior','lead','principal')),
  region         TEXT,     -- 'auckland' 'wellington' 'christchurch' 'other-nz' 'remote-nz'
  work_mode      TEXT CHECK (work_mode IS NULL OR work_mode IN ('onsite','hybrid','remote')),
  taxonomy_ver   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, -- 用哪一版规则归的；重跑时按这个筛

  -- 薪资：能解析出来才填。NZ 的岗位大多不写，所以这几列大部分是空的 ——
  -- 报表里必须同时给出「有薪资样本量」，否则中位数会骗人。
  salary_min     INTEGER,
  salary_max     INTEGER,
  salary_period  TEXT CHECK (salary_period IS NULL OR salary_period IN ('year','hour','day')),

  -- 区间（坑 2）
  first_seen_day TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (first_seen_day GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
  last_seen_day  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (last_seen_day  GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'),
  is_open        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_open IN (0,1)),
  posted_at      INTEGER,                    -- 来源站声称的发布时间，常常没有

  created_at     INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  updated_at     INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at > 0), role_group TEXT,
  UNIQUE (source, external_id)                -- 同一个岗位重复抓到只更新 last_seen
)

master.name: login_codes
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE "login_codes" (
  id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  email      TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE CHECK (length(email) > 0),
  code_hash  TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(code_hash) = 64),
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  attempts   INTEGER DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0),
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
)

master.name: messages
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE messages (
  id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  direction       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('out','in')),
  from_addr       TEXT,
  to_addr         TEXT,
  subject         TEXT,
  body            TEXT,
  -- AI 只做第一档：读懂、分类、摘要。起草和发送都是人的事。
  ai_intent       TEXT,
  ai_summary      TEXT,
  created_at      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0)
)

master.name: oauth_states
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE oauth_states (
  state      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  nonce      TEXT NOT NULL,
  next_path  TEXT,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

master.name: outcomes
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE outcomes (
  id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  account_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  job_id      TEXT,                    -- 可空：他可能是从别处拿到的面试
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('applied','interview','offer','accepted','rejected')),
  note        TEXT,
  happened_on TEXT,
  created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0)
)

master.name: resource_events
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE resource_events (
  id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  account_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  resource_id TEXT REFERENCES resources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL,
  event       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (event IN ('view','open')),
  day         TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0)
)

master.name: resource_saves
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE resource_saves (
  account_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  resource_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES resources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (account_id, resource_id)
)

master.name: resource_seen
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE "resource_seen" (
  account_id  TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES employers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kind        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('weekly','news','podcast')),
  seen_at     INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (seen_at > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (account_id, kind)
)

master.name: resources
master.sql:
CREATE TABLE resources (
  id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  kind         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('weekly','news','podcast')),
  slug         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(slug) > 0),
  title_i18n   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(title_i18n)
                                    AND json_extract(title_i18n, '$.en') IS NOT NULL),
  summary_i18n TEXT CHECK (summary_i18n IS NULL OR json_valid(summary_i18n)),
  url          TEXT,
  source       TEXT,

  -- 'solo' means everyone signed in. In code, read this as `!== 'solo'`, never
  -- as `=== 'runway'` — otherwise a future third tier becomes world-readable
  -- because nobody remembered to update one line.
  -- 代码里判定写「不等于 solo」而不是「等于 runway」——
  -- 否则以后加第三档时，会因为没人改那一行而默认全公开。
  min_plan     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'solo' CHECK (min_plan IN ('solo','runway')),

  status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'published' CHECK (status IN ('draft','published')),
  published_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (published_at > 0),
  created_at   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0),
  updated_at   INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE role_taxonomy (

  role_family TEXT,
  seniority   TEXT,
  priority    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 100,
  note        TEXT,
  created_at  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (created_at > 0)
)

  source       TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_at   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  finished_at  INTEGER,
  day          TEXT NOT NULL,
  seen_count   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,   -- 本次看到的岗位总数
  new_count    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ok           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (ok IN (0,1)),
  error        TEXT
)

)
